summary: A load of the plugins was activated, at startup or by a reload: the line names every package then active at its digest, and the routes frozen with it.

key.description: The id of the activated snapshot.

snapshot_id.description: The id of the activated snapshot, the same as the key.

source.description: Whether the runtime's start or a reload made the snapshot.

plugins.description: Every plugin of the snapshot, the unavailable ones included.

id.description: The plugin's id, which is its directory's name.

routes.description: The route snapshot the same act froze, by its counts: where each operation was being sent at the time.

snapshot_id.description: The id of the route snapshot.

global_default.description: The plugin the global default route names, or null where there is none.

override_count.description: How many global operation overrides there are.

campaign_route_count.description: How many campaign routes there are, each campaign's default and operation overrides together.
